evidence.reason: The launch record is appended after Popen but before the try/except cleanup block. If Recorder.append raises, boot exits without stopping or reaping the spawned systemd-run process and without closing the log, so the child QEMU can survive the caller's cleanup or start after the CLI exits. This is an ordinary exception-safety defect in existing intended behavior; moving the append into the guarded cleanup path without losing it on success is the smallest compatible fix.
